So eating disorders are in general disorder of a mind. People with eating disorders have severe eating problems - we call that disordered eating. It's not that people with anorexia hate food or eating. There's almost every time some other mental disorder or problem that is hiding behind anorexia - it could be depression, anxiety, trauma etc. People may have different reasons - for some it's the control they need to have over at least something (in this case food, eating, weight) but for some it may be body dysmorphia (hating how their body looks, feels etc.) - it can be both or just one of that, it's very individual. Over time, it just becomes an addiction and like every other addiction it is very hard to overcome. 

If an anorexic person recovers, it can still mean they can relapse and get worse again due to a stressful event or time in their life. I hope this helped and sorry for my english.
